items.title: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic resigns to run for prime minister in October elections
items.summary: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic stepped down as the country's head of state Sunday, paving the way for him to run as his right-wing populist Serbian Progressive Party's candidate for prime minister in the October parliamentary elections.
